Financial Statement Requirement
If accepted, international applicants who expect to hold F-1 or J-1 visa status must complete a financial statement showing evidence of adequate financial support to cover the costs of one full year of study.

English Proficiency Requirements
International applicants who do not meet the requirements for a waiver are required to submit English proficiency scores. English proficiency requirements vary by program.
